scope: Single common-initial-condition comparison of current affine-template P with RAS08 and deterministic MMD19 adaptations. No new gain search or statistical superiority claim.
supersedes: Two additional external trajectories on the frozen 46-member task; archived P trajectory is reused read-only.
templates: Time-varying ellipsoidal Gaussian roles with shared material frame. Smooth log-scale interpolations 8-24 and 68-86 s preserve horizontal target area; independent per-role axes. During the turn the shared frame follows survey-path orientation. Physical KDE bandwidths fixed. Affine material feedforward for actual member positions; fixed-time P metric/graph/center/shape decomposition evaluated in instantaneous axes.
backup: Geometry precheck selected tangent via relay reference; certify whole fleet under fixed velocity vector for each new certificate. Inherited prefix and infinite suffix retain their original direction; dynamic direction is never substituted during fallback.
evidence: Same initial positions/velocities, target dynamics, constraints and clocks. New adapter/geometry checks precede the two external trajectories.
criteria: Role-level nominal 68m world lateral traversals at forward station; report actual successful left and right relative extrema; report actual complete survey revolution when cumulative unwrapped angle exceeds 360° for each role center on stable stage. Quantify observed vs target material-axis widths/ratios per role and shape error, not just visual rotation. Single deterministic demonstration.
parameter_scope: Transferred gains previously selected on three independent initial conditions of an earlier task, not optimized on the current evaluation.
comparison: One matched initial condition, same task and metric windows; all failure and intervention records retained.
